definitions.gloss: full name; complete name including family name and given name
definitions.explanation: A person's complete name, as opposed to just their family name or given name alone. Used when specifying that the entire name is required.

examples.japanese: フルネームで{書|か}いてください。
{彼|かれ}のフルネームを{知|し}らない。
examples.english: I don't know his full name.

examples.japanese: {申込書|もうしこみしょ}にはフルネームと{住所|じゅうしょ}を{記入|きにゅう}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: You need to fill in your full name and address on the application form.

notes:
A wasei-eigo-style compound from English "full" + "name." While the component words are English, フルネーム is used naturally in Japanese and is well understood. In Japanese naming conventions, the full name consists of {姓|せい} (family name) followed by {名|めい} (given name).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フルネームで{書|か}く: to write one's full name
- フルネームで{呼|よ}ぶ: to call someone by their full name
- フルネームを{記入|きにゅう}する: to fill in one's full name
- フルネームで{検索|けんさく}する: to search by full name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {氏名|しめい}: full name — the formal/official term used on documents and forms
- {名前|なまえ}: name — can mean either full name or given name depending on context
- {本名|ほんみょう}: real name — as opposed to a stage name, pen name, or username
